title: Time origins or first observations shift at zero; crossing midnight reverses elapsed time
reproduction: Start with a control at 23:59:59.50, send at .75, ACK at 00:00:00.25 and send at .50. Separately repeat a send and an ACK first seen at 00:00:00.
expected: Use the documented first-packet origin for the time series, preserve actual zero timestamps and give elapsed intervals across midnight.
observed: Archived atime starts the ACK at 0.00 instead of 0.75. stime prints -86399.25 for the second send. packetdat overwrites the first send/ACK at zero; send-ack resets the age of an immediately repeated midnight send.
fix: Track initialization independently of timestamp values. Add one day for a backward jump greater than 12 hours; small regressions retain their sign. Date-less input cannot disambiguate long gaps, clock changes or records reordered across midnight.
test_evidence: test_shared_first_packet_and_rollover, test_midnight_origin_and_fractional_kbytes, test_packetdat_midnight_first_and_last and the two event tests compare formatted seconds.

title: Missing fields or non-record text produce invented sends and ACKs
reproduction: Use a blank line, a text heading, an ACK with no number and a data row with win instead of a range.
expected: Ignore incomplete observations without changing counts, time origin or event output.
observed: stime and send-ack print zero-byte records for text; packetdat counts two sends for a blank line plus heading. atime prints sequence zero for a missing ACK number.
fix: Check the legacy time and direction fields and require the sequence data used by each report. Ignored control packets may still establish the first-packet clock.
test_evidence: test_missing_records exercises three inputs against all four scripts; test_event_deltas_controls_and_unmatched_ack also checks valid records following a blank line.

title: Empty totals, missing chunk one and absent observations produce misleading numbers
reproduction: Use empty input; then send chunks two and four around midnight, ACK chunk two only, and leave chunk one absent.
expected: Print zero totals where appropriate, use an observed send as fallback origin and distinguish missing timings from measured zero.
observed: Empty input prints blank counts. Without chunk one a send time prints 86399.50; missing sends or ACKs become zero minus the origin (including plausible 0.00).
fix: Print integer counts. Retain the chunk-one origin when present, otherwise use the first observed send. Use -1.00 for unobserved times; preserve eight numeric columns and zero counts.
test_evidence: test_missing_records, test_packetdat_sparse_cumulative_and_unacked and test_packetdat_retains_chunk_order_and_chunk_one_origin check exact headers and rows.

title: ACK beyond the last observed send is dropped from implicit times
reproduction: At noon send 1:513(512); one second later read ACK 1025 without observing the next send.
expected: Chunk one inherits the covering ACK time with zero explicit ACKs for that chunk. Do not invent another chunk.
observed: Archived chunk one reports -43200.00 for both ACK times even though the cumulative ACK covers its end.
fix: Seed the descending implicit-time pass with the nearest explicitly acknowledged chunk above the output range; never extend the range based on an ACK.
test_evidence: test_packetdat_ack_beyond_last_send checks a 1.00 implicit time, zero explicit count and an ACK-only header without data rows.

title: Immediate repeats and late hole fills are mislabeled; ACKs inherit send flags
reproduction: Send chunk one twice, skip chunk two, ACK chunk one, then send the missing chunk.
expected: Mark the observed repeat, mark the forward hole, leave the first observed hole fill unmarked, and keep send annotations off ACKs.
observed: Archived output gives the duplicate no star, the ACK a dash from the preceding send, and the first hole fill a star.
fix: Use observed end-sequence membership for repeats and advance the high-water mark only for a new higher endpoint. Format ACKs without the send marker.
test_evidence: test_event_order_flags_and_retransmit_age checks exact gap, repeat and short-send markers, repeated ACK counts and original-send age.

title: Skipped controls emit blank lines and shorten the next event delta
reproduction: Place a SYN before a send and a FIN between a send and an ACK.
expected: Retain the first valid packet as origin, emit nothing for skipped control sends and compute deltas from the last emitted event.
observed: Every skipped control prints a newline and updates the previous-event time.
fix: Skip the control after clock normalization and before printing a line or advancing the previous-event timestamp.
test_evidence: test_event_deltas_controls_and_unmatched_ack checks exactly three lines and a 0.75 second send-to-ACK delta despite the intervening control.

title: Missing send or window is printed as a measured delay or a zero window
reproduction: At noon send 1:513(512); one second later read ACK 1025 with no window and no matching send endpoint.
expected: Keep the numeric delay slot, mark an unavailable age and print a window only when present.
observed: Archived event prints win 0 and (43201.00), effectively measuring the unmatched ACK from midnight.
fix: Test send membership before subtracting and use -1.00 when unmatched. Only update the remembered window for an explicit numeric win field.
test_evidence: test_event_deltas_controls_and_unmatched_ack checks (-1.00) with no window, then a real win 0 and a matched (1.00) delay.
